correctness.rationale: For balanced complete k-partite graph with n per part (k>=3,n>=2), reconstructed L+ pseudoinverse from within-part zero sum and between-part contrast eigenspaces. Transfer-current determinant gives offdiagonal Cov(X_e,X_f)=-(b_e^T L+ b_f)^2 and variance r(1-r). The orthogonal block tensor decomposition gives zero plus L,A,T,H and for k>=4 B spectra with stated multiplicities; explicit positive differences yield strict order and condition number 2 at k=3 and 2+2/[k(kn-2)] for k>=4. Independent Laplacian pseudoinverse and numerical diagonalization for (k,n)=(3,2),(4,2),(3,3) matched all eigenvalues to 5e-16. Finite matrices corroborate, while general algebra establishes all parameters.
